resume: CTL-1 turns the FM-1 into a MIDI controller: keys with velocity and aftertouch, scales with their chords on the black keys, four banks of knobs, an arpeggiator and a Euclidean drum sequencer. Everything goes out over USB and Bluetooth, and the FM-1 also plays General MIDI sounds.

commandes.role: Next controller bank; held, KNOB 1 to 4 set the controller numbers.
Subpages of the page: the banks on Play, the tracks on the sequencer.
Play notes; with a scale, its notes are on the white keys and its chords on the black ones.

gestes: FX held + KNOB 1 to 4: controller numbers.
a_savoir: The ctl-usb file has the same content without Bluetooth.
